article.headline: Montana State earns 58-53 victory over Northern Arizona
article.description: — Brandon Walker's 17 points helped Montana State defeat Northern Arizona 58-53 on Saturday night to end the Bobcats' six-game losing streak.
article.linkText: Montana State earns 58-53 victory over Northern Arizona
article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- — Brandon Walker's 17 points helped Montana State defeat Northern Arizona 58-53 on Saturday night to end the Bobcats' six-game losing streak. Walker added seven rebounds for the Bobcats (6-11, 1/3 Big Sky Conference). Bryce Zephir scored 10 points, going 4 of 6 from the field. Tyler Patterson went 3 of 6 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with eight points. The win broke a six-game skid for the Bobcats. The Lumberjacks (10-7, 1-3) were led by Trenton McLaughlin, who posted 24 points. Carson Towt added 12 points and 17 rebounds for Northern Arizona. Jayden Jackson had eight points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
